questions.question: Blood clot is formed because of the presence of certain cells in the blood called:
questions.solution:
__
 
• Blood clot is formed because of the presence of certain cells in the blood called **platelets**__.
 
• Platelets are small blood cells that prevent body from forming clots in order to stop bleeding.
 
• Chondrocytes are the cells which are found in the cartilage connective tissue.
 
• Lymphocytes are white blood cells found in lymph and blood tissue.
 
• Erythrocytes are the cells which carry oxygen to the body and contain haemoglobin.

questions.question: Which of the following is known as the powerhouse of the cell?

• The endoplasmic reticulum is a membrane system that functions as a packaging and manufacturing system.
 
• The nucleus is an organelle which contains DNA of eukaryotic organisms.
 
• The cytoplasm is enclosed by a cell membrane and is a thick fluid which fills each cell.

questions.question: Select the water-soluble vitamin among the following.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin C**__.

__
 
• **Vitamin C**__ is a water-soluble vitamin.
 
• Water-soluble vitamins are those which can be dissolved in water.
 
• They are not stored in the body and are found in animal and plant foods.
 
• Vitamins K, E, D, and A are fat-soluble vitamins.
 
• Fat-soluble vitamins are those which dissolve in oils and fats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin A**: It is also called Retinol. Deficiency of Vitamin A leads to a disease called Nyctalopia (night blindness) where the patient suffers from poor vision at night. Also, it may cause premature death in children below the age of 5.
 
• Vitamin D: It is also called Calciferol. It helps in the absorption of calcium dissolved in the blood, It prevents the weakening of bone and tooth. Vitamin D also has other functions in the body, including cell growth, neuromuscular and immune function, and reduction of inflammation. Vitamin D deficiency can cause rickets in children and osteomalacia in adults. 
 
• Vitamin C: It is also known as ascorbic acid. It acts as an antioxidant. It is an essential nutrient for the body as it is involved in tissue repair and enzyme-related functions. A deficiency of vitamin C can cause a disease known as scurvy
 
• Vitamin K: It is also called Phytonadione. Vitamin K is responsible for blood coagulation. Without vitamin K, blood coagulation is seriously impaired, and uncontrolled bleeding occurs.

questions.question: Which among the following is the longest river of Peninsular India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Godavari**__.​

 
• Godavari is the largest peninsular river in India.

 
 
• The second longest river in India after the Ganga.
 
• Originates from Triambakeshwar, Maharashtra.
 
• Flowing through Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh states.
 
• Also known as Vridha Ganga.
 
• Major left-bank tributaries: Purna, Pranhita, Indravati, and Sabari river.
 
• Major right bank tributaries: Pravara, Manjira, and Manair river.
 
• The Pranhita river is the largest tributary of Godavari.
 
• Important dams built across the Godavari river: Jayakwadi dam, Gangapur Dam, Babli project, and Sriram Sagar Dam.
 
• The Coringa mangrove forest is situated in Godavari delta.
 
 
 
• The Barakar River is the main tributary of the Damodar River.
 
• The river Manjira is the main source of drinking water for Hyderabad and Secunderabad.
